item: The loops init_db runs on the main thread end in a guard clause, and a ratchet pins them (audit 0.5.0 A-012, routing 11)
refs: PR #1489; audit 0.5.0 A-012; follows PR #1471 and R205
summary: A for loop whose last statement is a bare if leaves its back-edge between two exception-table entries on CPython 3.13, so a KeyboardInterrupt there skips the with, finally or except BaseException around it (audit leak rates under real SIGALRM: for-ending-in-if under a with 1,460 of 3,000, under try/finally 1,608 of 2,986; plain for and the guard-clause form 0). serve calls init_db before it installs its signal handlers, so these steps run where an interrupt is delivered. The 28 column steps of maintenance.py (the ensure_* loops and _add_missing_columns, each `for name, ddl in COLUMNS.items(): if name not in existing: ...`) and install_source_outlet_id (whose except BaseException rolls its BEGIN IMMEDIATE back) now read `if name in existing: continue` and run the body after it, behaviour unchanged; damage.py repair_upsert (a for/break/else under the registry lock) searches in a function of its own and settle_interrupted_repairs takes the guard form, both worker-only today (R165) and converted so a CLI that reaches the registry later inherits it. tests/test_init_db_loops_survive_an_interrupt.py reads the compiled code with the dis helper of test_gates_survive_an_interrupt.py over every ensure_* of maintenance.py and source_identity.py plus the named functions (38 cases, 28 red without the change) and is deliberately not tree-wide, as the audit ruled. upgrade_sources_to_composite_key keeps its schema reads inside the try: old_cols must be read after add_feed_key_column, and its inlined comprehension heads were already moved out by R205, so no uncovered head is left there. Not converted: worker-only and event-loop loops, and vacuum_preflight / maybe_incremental_vacuum, which the helper flags but which init_db does not reach (the scheduler runs maybe_incremental_vacuum; vacuum_preflight has no with or finally of its own). Battery: 1,842 passed, 6 skipped over every test file that names these functions.
